frame_index: k = row * cols + col; yaw = k * yaw_step_deg, clockwise from screen-up
pitch_definition: degrees from nadir (0 = looking straight down, 60 = towards the horizon) - the same as MapLibre `pitch`

selection.bucket: single frame (viewport-aligned billboard: identical at every pitch and map bearing)
selection.warp: none - draw unrotated and unscaled, anchor at `anchor`
selection.ground: the stalk's foot contact shadow is NOT baked as a ground ellipse: draw a separate map-aligned circle (circle-pitch-alignment: map) so it squashes with the pitch
selection.scale: constant on screen: draw the frame at frame_dp, independent of zoom and pitch

shadow.light: upper-left, fixed to the screen (soft drop shadow of the object itself)

licence: original procedural model built in Blender from primitives; no third-party geometry, textures or fonts
